questions.stem: A scatter graph shows points going from bottom-left to top-right. What type of correlation is this?
questions.explanation: Points going from bottom-left to top-right indicate a positive correlation — as one variable increases, the other also increases.

questions.stem: A scatter graph shows that as temperature increases, the number of coats sold decreases. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: As one variable (temperature) increases, the other (coats sold) decreases. This is negative correlation.
